name: Rayquaza (CobbleEffort form)
look: a far longer Rayquaza wound in coils: a white front half traced with glowing red hexagon chains and a fiery chest crack, white blades fanning back from its shoulders, two red ribbons of hexagonal links from its head, and a black rear half ringed with glowing yellow circles and red-rimmed hexagonal fins
entry: Far longer than any Rayquaza, it has never once touched the ground. It sleeps coiled on the wind high above the peaks, and when it uncoils, the storms it rides stretch from one horizon to the other.
how: Wild: ultra-rare in mountain peaks above y 150, and the sky.
